title: A proper smooth model on an analytic neighborhood yields a local meromorphic rational point
author: Mehmeti, Vlerë
work: An analytic viewpoint on the Hasse principle

contexts.scope: Entire authoredmathematicalbody, globalsetting/vertexsets/localnewlemmas and nativeeditableTikZ retained; otherclaims contextonly

difficulty_reason: The argument constructs a strict affinoid neighborhood and a regular curve model whose specialization fiber simultaneously preserves the analytic neighborhood and realizes its bounded-function ring as a complete two-dimensional regular local ring. Its new local core then descends rational points through two successive discrete valuation rings and applies Hensel lifting, using the precise compatibility of their valuations with the ground field. Standard properness and Hensel lemmas alone do not supply that analytic-to-local-algebra construction; the full authored construction and nested auxiliary proofs are preserved and exceed ordinary PhD qualification exercises.
